🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Charlotte Sands announce Satellite Tour for April 2027

Charlotte Sands has booked a UK and European headline run for April 2027 behind her second album Satellite. Germany gets four dates, in Cologne, Hamburg, Berlin and Munich, and the tour closes at London's Electric Ballroom on 21 April.

📣 JUST ANNOUNCED: Foo Fighters announce Düsseldorf stadium show for 2027

Foo Fighters will play an exclusive German stadium show at the Merkur Spiel-Arena in Düsseldorf on 17 June 2027. The Hives are on the bill.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: The Menzingers announce European tour for early 2027

The Menzingers head to Europe in February and March 2027 behind their upcoming album Everything I Ever Saw on Epitaph Records. The Flatliners support on every date, and the route runs from Antwerp on 22 February to London on 13 March.
